summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend admin/landing testing for SecureCBT. Backend pytest: 14/14 pass covering auth, admin (tokens/questions/disc/config/results/stats), full exam flow (start→answer→session resume→tkj/submit→disc answer→disc/submit→token completed→reuse denied), violations auto-submit (3x tab-switch), SEB toggle gating. Frontend Playwright: admin login → dashboard KPIs → token generate → bank soal (28 questions listed + Tambah Soal dialog opens) → hasil table populated with 6 participants and Detail links → konfigurasi save button present → landing page invalid token error shows correctly.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby on DialogContent (a11y minor)

action_items: Optional: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to admin dialogs to silence a11y warning
Optional: Consider cleaning up abandoned 'active' participants (e.g., TEST_seb left in Sedang TKJ) — expiry via tkj_started_at window works only on next /exam/start call
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exam_start: when token status=='active' & re-entered, allows any name/school/class inputs to reuse existing participant — session is preserved which is correct, but caller-provided name/school/class are ignored silently (acceptable but worth documenting)
In-memory rate_limit dict (_rate) is per-process; not shared across workers/replicas. Fine for single instance
verify_seb: when BEK is empty, any SEB header value passes (documented in problem statement — expected)
server.py ~730 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider modularization into routers/services
seed_data_creation: Generated several TEST_ tokens & participants during test runs. Config restored to defaults (require_seb=false, tkj=60/25, disc=20, threshold=3) at end of tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully verified via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 14 tests). Frontend admin flows verified with Playwright. Not tested via full browser automation: /preflight camera/screen (needs getUserMedia flags), /exam room UI interactions (would need to seed exam_session in localStorage and manage fullscreen overlay). Config is restored to defaults. Rate limit 10/min per IP on /exam/start — be mindful.
